name: oah-mondego
description: Statistical early-warning detection (EWMA control chart) plus downstream contamination-propagation forecasting across two real European river networks -- the Mondego (Coimbra, Portugal) and the cross-border Douro/Duero (Spain-Portugal) -- serialized as FHIR R4 RiskAssessment predictions and served over an Express CDS Hooks (v3.0 ballot) service, in support of the EU-funded OneAquaHealth One Health surveillance mission.
